title: Edgar Mitchell on the Moon landing imagery
summary: James Fox tells of Edgar Mitchell on the Moon landing imagery, about 1971 at The Moon, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: "James, it wouldn't surprise me." me. He goes, "We had hustleblot cameras with no viewfinders, gardening gloves on."

plain: James Fox, a documentary filmmaker, says on Jesse Michels's podcast that he once asked astronaut Edgar Mitchell, who walked on the Moon on the Apollo 14 mission in 1971, about the photographs from the landings. According to Fox, Mitchell said, "James, it wouldn't surprise me," and explained they worked with Hasselblad cameras that had no viewfinders while wearing bulky gloves, which suggests the pictures may not all be what they seem.
